name: dp-sk-judikatura-grab
description: Downloads Supreme Court of the Slovak Republic decisions from the nsud.sk OpenData API by decision-date window, plus PDF attachments of decisions without API text. Writes files.
author: open-lex-it

execute.description: For each item list the ids of its month window, fetch each decision once and write decision.json, attachment.pdf and fetch.json under dir. Files of the same version are kept.

items.description: the items to download, as reported by the detect step

maxDocs.description: stop after this many ids per item

includePdfOnly.description: download the PDF of decisions without API text (default true)

baseUrl.description: https://www.nsud.sk or a replay server on host.docker.internal

output.description: { dir, items: [{key, listed, taken, skipped_existing, pdf_only}], metrics: {listed, taken, skipped_existing, pdf_only} }
